request_shape.context_transport: root-owned regular temporary file, mode 0600, delivered over authenticated SSH stdin; removed by MCC EXIT trap
request_shape.context_sha256: SHA-256 over canonical complete context bytes including signature
request_shape.signature: HMAC-SHA256 hex over canonical context body excluding signature, key is MCC settings.jwt_secret and is never disclosed to MCD
request_shape.timestamps: timezone-aware ISO 8601 UTC; maximum lifetime 1800 seconds; issued_at may not exceed now by more than 30 seconds
request_shape.nonce: token_urlsafe(18); retries are idempotent only while the exact bound MCC job remains queued or running

response_shape.binding_rule: every echoed binding field must equal the locally verified request context; response fields are not a source of authorization

phase_semantics.meaning: MCC authorizes the configured release transition at the upgrade phase; the immutable patch plan remains separately bound to its dependency_update_preflight audit phase

transition_requirements.source: exact MCC policy edge selected by the signed transition_id, policy_revision and policy_sha256

database_compatibility.empty_means: no transition-specific database profile; retain ordinary MCD checks

transition_requirements.validation: MCC checks the context policy hash against current policy before returning; MCD rejects unknown fields, wrong JSON types, malformed versions and enum values, then enforces each requirement independently. The package-level 1.2.67 floor and runtime capability are separate from this per-edge minimum.
